sentence_stem: Although the article presented strong statistics,
correct_completion: several readers questioned how the data had been collected.
full_sentence: Although the article presented strong statistics, several readers questioned how the data had been collected.
acceptable_variants: many people still doubted its conclusions.
the editors later added a correction about the sample size.

options.text: so the readers trusted every claim.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast, but this option expresses agreement and a result, so it does not complete the contrast.

options.text: several readers questioned how the data had been collected.
the article was published in a newspaper.
options.why_wrong: This adds neutral background information but does not provide the contrasting reaction expected after 'although'.

options.text: the statistics were presented in a table.
options.why_wrong: This describes the format of the presentation, which does not contrast with the strength of the statistics.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a contrast with the first part of the sentence. Polish speakers often reach for a second contrast marker in the main clause, but English needs only one contrast connector in this structure.
translation: Chociaż artykuł przedstawiał mocne statystyki, kilku czytelników kwestionowało sposób, w jaki zebrano dane.
